sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (policy schedule dependent); illustrations show ₹5,00,000 and above; unlimited SI option also mentioned

room_rent.note: Base policy has no limit on room rent. Optional Benefit 'Room Rent Modification' can downgrade to Single Private AC Room / Twin Sharing / General Ward / ₹3,000/day if opted.

icu.note: No separate restriction on ICU charges. Room Rent Modification optional benefit also states no limit on ICU charges.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base plan. Optional co-payment can be opted (Clause 3.2.29) for premium discount. Smart Select optional benefit adds 20% co-pay for non-network or reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure sub-limits in base policy wording. All covered treatments paid up to Sum Insured.

deductible.note: No base deductible. Optional Benefit 'Deductible' (Clause 3.2.28) can be opted for premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period (Excl03). Can be modified via Optional Benefit 'Initial Wait Period Modification'.

ped_waiting.note: Standard PED waiting period is 36 months. Can be reduced via Optional Benefit 'PED Wait Period Modification' or waived for specific conditions via 'Instant Cover'.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Named ailment waiting period of 24 months (Excl02) for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc. Can be modified via Optional Benefit 'Named Ailment Wait Period Modification'.

maternity.note: Maternity Cover is an optional benefit (Clause 3.2.15). Waiting period as specified in Policy Schedule. Coverage up to specified % of SI per policy year, accumulates up to 3x if no claim. Age 18-45 years. New Born Baby Cover also optional.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI added per completed claim-free or claim year (bonus accrues even on claim years), capped at 100% of SI. Optional 'Infinity Bonus' adds further 100%/yr unlimited.

restoration.note: Unlimited Automatic Recharge reinstates full base SI unlimited times per year after exhaustion. Applicable from 2nd claim in a policy year. Can be used for same or different illness. Optional 'Unlimited Automatic Recharge Booster' makes it available from 1st claim in lifetime.

pre_hosp.note: Can be extended via Optional Benefit 'Pre-Post Hospitalization Expenses Modification'.

post_hosp.note: Can be extended via Optional Benefit 'Pre-Post Hospitalization Expenses Modification'.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered up to Sum Insured.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI for treatment exceeding 3 consecutive days. Excludes 12 listed conditions (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to SI with minimum 24-hour hospitalisation requirement. In-patient only.

organ_donor.note: Donor's hospitalisation expenses for organ transplant covered up to SI. Post-harvesting expenses of donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road, air, and train ambulance covered up to Sum Insured. No separate sub-limit stated.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed advanced technology methods covered including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy (haematological), etc.

consumables.note: Optional Benefit 'Claim Shield' (Clause 3.2.11) covers non-medical/consumable items from List I-IV (Annexure I) that are otherwise excluded. Not covered in base plan.

global_cover.note: Optional Benefit 'Travel Plus' (Clause 3.2.39) covers emergency in-patient and OPD treatment outside India for specified continuous days per policy year. Includes loss of passport, baggage, trip cancellation/interruption.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no look-back except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period except if premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines. Apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary excl. for 12 conditions (asthma, diabetes, hypertension etc.); hormone replacement therapy; tobacco/alcohol-related illness; stem cell (non-haematological); hazardous sports (professional)

optional_riders.display: Infinity Bonus, Unlimited Care, Claim Shield, Instant Cover, PED Wait Modification, Maternity Cover, Cancer Care, Travel Plus, Inflation Shield, Tenure Multiplier, Room Rent Modification, Deductible, Co-payment, OPD benefits
